legacy.hashSemantics: Unchanged normalization, profile, frozen identity/history, media annotations, private digest, seal and manifest hash interpretation

native.separateFrom: activity-completion/3 is a different receipt namespace; publication v2 does not admit development completion v2.

dispatch: Strict revision/kind tuple -> one validator; never try native then legacy. Missing/unknown/contradictory discriminants fail closed.

typeStrategy.SnapshotPrivate/SnapshotResult: Retain named legacy aliases; introduce separate native private types, not optional fake legacy fields
typeStrategy.nativePrivate: contract + source projection + dependencies + result.manifest + result.report.sourceRevision + typed native bindings; no legacy services/tts/speech/capsules/history structures
typeStrategy.downstreamReturnTypes: Legacy shapes unchanged; generic repository and new native reader handle the union.

initialNativeCapabilityScope.purpose: Canonical publication certification for read-only durable execution facts; not generalized media/player publication enablement
initialNativeCapabilityScope.supported: Native teaching text and single_choice Activity blocks using existing Manifest types, without fixed chapter number, script version1, activity alias, option count3 or attempts2 requirements. Exactly one completion-counted Activity per execution node for the initial validated node-progress projection; unsupported node aggregation fails closed. Multiple such nodes/Activities per chapter are permitted.
initialNativeCapabilityScope.media: Initial producer admits no required media/cue execution dependencies. Empty media sets are valid only for genuinely text/choice source. Authored required video/audio/speech/listening/cue or unsupported activity/config semantics must cause a compile rejection, never be silently dropped or filled with legacy fixtures. Future native media/cue certification is separately scoped.
initialNativeCapabilityScope.manifestExecution: Omit optional development native-execution/1; do not synthesize fixed Node5/Node7 or a fake video. Teaching source bindings remain private certified associations. current cursor remains unknown.
initialNativeCapabilityScope.rationale: The requested native facts/Skill prerequisite needs genuine source/binding certification, not an unapproved general video/media runtime redesign. This bounded capability choice is explicit in the new approval proposal.

sourceAndAssociationRules: One existing capture_runtime_publication_v1 result supplies all content, secrets and dependencies; producer does not refetch a different content graph.

Validate actual textbook -> version -> chapter -> modules -> execution nodes -> Activities graph and exact requested PublicationScope. Modules have no invented published flag: parent publication and membership are checked.

Require existing published textbook/version/chapter, teaching lesson/profile/script version states as applicable to unchanged StudentPolicy; one unambiguous published script per selected teaching lesson. Unknown states/ambiguous bindings fail.

Use learning_agent_script_nodes.reference_activity_id as the explicit source-teaching-node to Activity association, validate same captured lesson/module/chapter/version. Select the requested Activity from the verified source-node binding, never first Activity/title/question-text/alias inference. Duplicate or absent association is not authorization.

B1 authoring inserted node.content={} and activity.public_config={} and did not write source-node reference_activity_id. It is NOT permission to auto-publish B1 or infer Node7. Only new isolated published fixtures with genuine explicit captured associations are used; any future source authoring requires separate approval.

Distinguish catalog lessons.id (textbook.lesson_id), learning_agent_lessons.id and script version lesson_id. Catalog/enrollment/tenant authorization remains live StudentPolicy, not immutable publication evidence or a new capture table.

Validate public prompt/options projection, Activity type, max_attempts, completion participation, one actual grader secret per answer-graded Activity and matching node/source references. No answer, private definition digest or raw secret appears in public Manifest/Tool DTO.

Source revision/native pins derive deterministically from validated captured content and the native compiler contract, not Chapter One profile or history. Preserve exact captured dependency JSON for the DB fence; do not normalize it a second incompatible way.

Use existing generic Manifest structural validator with published=true plus native source-binding certification. Native blocks require compatibility.native, no compat capsules, no legacy media-admission exceptions, no unsupported external references.

Public contentDigest hashes safe semantic Manifest excluding snapshot metadata. Native snapshot ID is opaque server-generated publication identity, not an exposed answer-derived hash. Private capture/secret digest and outer seal stay server-private; native same-ID/different-payload publication is rejected by existing collision checks.

Always assert the exact stored dependency fence and current authoring/retirement eligibility before live facts admission. Historical parse/readability does not revive retired/expired/revoked sessions.
futureReadChain: Verified Student Run + existing StudentPolicy/selection revalidation
server-resolved exact publication scope and source teaching node
one fixed verified DB transport READ ONLY snapshot
artifact revision/kind certification and dependency fence on same snapshot
trusted durable repository read/projection on same snapshot
snapshotTransactionSeam: Extend the official repository rpc-only client seam and approved durable repository read seam to share a single verified pg connection/snapshot. No second publication store/read authority. No publication session issue/request lease writes for a Tool read. The read is READ ONLY, retirement/fence checked, fresh observation-bound and revalidated; mutation-capable runtime request leases remain for existing write runtimes.
productionVsOperator: Owner remains publication operator only. Student authority remains formal active self subject/tenant; service infrastructure credentials are not subject identity. No B2/dev/Owner issuer.
producerPolicy: Same publisher module, explicit server-side producer choice. Preserve legacy write operations for now: repo/tests/history/rollback depend on them and live/external dependency deletion safety was not audited. Never select legacy as recovery from native failure.
